Generated machines currently hard-code `Fact = ()`, require handlers to return nothing, and emit empty fact vectors. The lifter likewise emits `__umpire_facts' = <<>>`. Changing only the activity state and handlers cannot meet R5; emitting facts only natively also breaks backend replay’s outcome/fact comparison.
items.suggestion: Specify the narrow deadline-fact authoring contract and include its macro, source-lowering and replay work. Require matching native/TLC facts for each expiration and empty facts for ordinary transitions.
